versions.title: DG Manager 1.0.0 initial release
versions.summary: DG Manager 1.0.0 ships with support for DG-5F.

items.text: Initial release of DG Manager with DG-5F support

versions.title: Firmware update feature added
versions.summary: Added firmware update capability and improved the user experience.

items.text: Added firmware update feature
Loading a recipe from the main screen now opens that recipe page automatically
Manual updates
Added controller guide button to main screen
Miscellaneous style adjustments
Fixed inconsistency between manual and guide buttons
Fixed recipe update bugs
Added DG-3F-M support
Display current index during blend playback
Data restore feature
Fixed CSV monitoring data being filled from the start
Fixed main-screen default selection always defaulting to the first item
Fixed error popup showing twice
Fixed recipe edit/input issues

versions.title: Connection feedback and memory stability
versions.summary: Added visual feedback for connection state and resolved memory issues on forced disconnect/reconnect.

items.text: Added UI indicators for disconnect/connect callbacks
Fixed memory issue when reconnecting after a forced disconnect
Updated data-restore validation to treat 0 as a valid value

versions.title: Korean manual display fix
versions.summary: Fixed an issue where the Korean manual was not displayed correctly.

items.text: Fixed bug where Korean manual was not displayed

versions.title: Linux support (g++20)
versions.summary: DGManager and SDK now support Linux (built with g++20).

items.text: Due to FFI limitations on Linux, DGManager uses get functions instead of callbacks to fetch data
From 1.2.0 onward, gripper port 2607 is no longer used for general communication and is reserved for boot mode only
Fixed new blend not being enabled after clearing all blends

versions.title: Port 2607 reserved and UI polish
versions.summary: Port 2607 is now reserved for firmware updates, and fingertip sensor UI has been improved.

items.text: Blocked port 2607 (reserved for firmware updates)
Improved fingertip sensor UI
Fixed Korean manual not displaying due to case sensitivity

versions.title: Fingertip sensor UI improvements
versions.summary: Fingertip sensor UI has been improved.

items.text: Improved fingertip sensor UI

versions.title: Modbus RTU review and Ubuntu 20.04 support
versions.summary: Shipped alongside DGSDK 1.3.0. Connection timeout extended from 30s to 50s.

items.text: DGSDK 1.3.0 released
Modbus RTU support reviewed
Connection timeout 30s → 50s
Added Ubuntu 20.04 support
Updated fingertip sensor zero-data image and related functions
Fixed items outside boot recipe not refreshing in UI during backup
Fixed program freeze when restarting blend after an early preview exit
Fixed low-pass filter state not reflected in UI
Control mode gain (PD/PID) state not received — under investigation
Added 6 default poses for the 3FB model
Fixed initial control values not loading in UI position-grab state

versions.title: iLimit state handling and stability
versions.summary: Added iLimit state handling alongside adjustments to firmware update checks.

items.text: iLimit state handling
Firmware update check cadence — current: every 10s / planned: disconnect detection → ping check → connection confirm
Expanded comport input length from 8 bytes → 32 bytes (improves Linux compatibility)
Lab button now disabled in User Mode

versions.title: DG-4F support
versions.summary: DGManager and SDK support DG-4F. UI layout and related adjustments were made to accommodate the new model.

items.text: DG-4F base degree of freedom is controlled by motors #17 and #18 in order
Recipe backup in user mode now permits option setup afterward
Added wake-lock to prevent communication drops when running in background
Font reference delay when launching GPIO screen in offline mode (fixed in builds after 8/26)
FT sensor force arrow too small to see clearly (fixed in builds after 8/26)

versions.title: DG-2F and DG-1F SDK integration
versions.summary: DGManager and the SDK now support DG-2F and DG-1F.

items.text: Fixed error occurring when adjusting offsets
Added SDK functions for DG-4F
Fixed GPIO controls not responding

versions.title: Official DG-2F and DG-1F support
versions.summary: Official support added for DG-2F and DG-1F.

items.text: Added progress indicator to Connect screen
Added drag to create Blends in Recipe Manager
Updated URDF
Blend Loop and STL extraction available via hidden command (not official features)
Fixed log extraction issue on the Linux build

versions.title: SDK version sync
versions.summary: Version bump tied to the matching SDK release.

versions.title: SDK version sync
versions.summary: Version bump tied to the matching SDK release.

items.text: Fixed issue occurring when changing IP on DG-1F / DG-2F

versions.title: DG-5F-S15 support and full UI/UX overhaul
versions.summary: Added DG-5F-S15 model support along with broad UI/UX improvements and numerous bug fixes.

items.text: Added DG-5F-S15 model support (URDF, HTML structure, feature mapping)
Added Received Data Types selector to Connect screen (synced with monitoring & settings)
Added origin reference option to STL extraction
Improved GPIO UX (cable color indicators)
Added tactile sensor screen
Added recipe double-click selection and blend count display
Added version info on Connect screen
Restored Control Cycle display
Added STL extraction to Dashboard
Added locale-based homepage URL routing on Info screen
Changed connection loading message to English
Improved Spy screen styling
Improved Sensor screen styling
Updated 3D viewer highlighting for better visibility
Reduced DAE file sizes for DG-1F / DG-2F (decimated)
Added NSIS installer configuration
Reduced build size
Enhanced Linux support and connection handling
Fixed scroll-ratio mismatch when zooming Spy screen
Fixed Ready button being disabled on double-Enter
Fixed HTML mapping errors for specific grippers
Fixed 3D viewer errors
Fixed flicker on Monitoring screen
Fixed DG-2F joint update error on Control screen
Fixed initial data issues on DG-1F / DG-2F
Fixed visibility of zero values in User mode
